indicator_name: Factors behind finished-goods price changes by sector: share of enterprises citing each factor (NBK enterprise survey)
description: Факторы изменения цен на готовую продукцию по отраслям: доля предприятий, отметивших фактор (мониторинг НБК)
methodology: NBK formId=384, quarterly from 2020-Q2. Item FACTOR.SECTOR (sectors as CAPACITY_UTILIZATION_BY_SECTOR: TOTAL, ОКЭД letters, NRS). Several factors per respondent, so shares do not sum to 100.
